proof_role: Matched accepted-predecessor and candidate prepared-start timing and operator-input inventory
determinism: Semantic inputs and assertions fixed; physical durations observational and host-dependent
resources: Local CPU, Git, candidate binaries and fixture disk; no live remote or paid resources
release_gate: Required local SIM-03 evidence; an ignored CI test is not a passing measurement
required_environment: ADL_SIM03_BASELINE_BINARY points to accepted #868 candidate, checked against fixed BLAKE3 identity
selection_controls: ADL_ISSUE873_TIMING_VARIANT accepts matched, candidate or predecessor; ADL_ISSUE873_TIMING_REPETITIONS accepts 1 through 3. The default remains three matched pairs. The issue #873 execute-only replay admits candidate plus one repetition only.
sample_plan: Default: three matched pairs with alternating predecessor/candidate order. Bounded issue #873 follow-up: one candidate-first sample from a separately staged harness. Both use the same semantic plan and isolated fixture family.
interval: Prepared state through inspect, bind and successful native validation, including required caller request/registration materialization
non_claims: The candidate-first execute-only mode does not itself establish an OS-cold cache or shared-host cache reset
Fixture timings do not prove live network or full repository workflow latency
Accepted predecessor in-process authority-read counts are unavailable rather than zero
